I selected a dataset on rate of access antibiotics use in all care settings in Defined Daily Doses per 1000 inhabitants per day.
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
antibiotics <- read_csv("data/week1proj.csv")
gt(antibiotics)
```
```{r}
antibiotics <- read_csv("data/week1proj.csv")
ggplot(antibiotics, aes(
  x=date,
  y=metric_value
))+
  geom_line(colour="blue")+
  xlab("Date")+
  ylab("DID")+
  ggtitle("Rate of Antibiotic Consumption")
```
